purpose: Repeatable protocol and positive/negative controls, not a claim that real generated films have passed
media_policy: CPU controls are synthesized locally. Real clips must be explicitly attached with checksum and independent human labels; no downloaded model or paid generation in CI.

causality.label: 剧情因果
causality.pass_rule: Visible setup, choice and consequence in the approved order; no unsupported knowledge or missing causal event
causality.repair: 补充可见前因、动机或主动选择；仅返修相关剧情镜头

identity.label: 角色一致性
identity.pass_rule: Same stable identity across time, shots and pinned character references; state/wardrobe changes judged separately
identity.repair: 固定身份参考版本，简化构图，重制发生漂移的关键帧

props.label: 道具连续性
props.pass_rule: Prop count, identity and owner changes have visible or approved narrative support
props.repair: 明确交接镜头及持物状态，不用参考图背景代替实际画面证据

dialogue.label: 对白清晰度
dialogue.pass_rule: Blind ASR CER reported separately from tone-marked phonetic error; no clipping, overlap or truncation; human listening still required
dialogue.repair: 复听低置信片段，改写长对白或调整录音与混音；不要只提高语速

action.label: 镜头动作
action.pass_rule: Requested single action readable across temporal samples; camera-only movement is not character acting
action.repair: 拆分或简化动作，减少同时运动的人物与物体

subtitles.label: 字幕
subtitles.pass_rule: SRT time bounds, ordering and text match delivered dialogue; visibility and occlusion need visual review
subtitles.repair: 修复字幕时间、文字或安全区；必要时仅重合成，不重生成视频

delivery.label: 完整交付
delivery.pass_rule: All planned shots and required exports decode and match immutable receipts; correct duration, dimensions and audio
delivery.repair: 恢复已完成素材下载，修复编码或漏剪，不重投未知云任务

cases.positive: S01拾得书籍；S02核对特征；S03归还并得到回应
cases.negative: 归还发生在拾得之前且没有倒叙依据

cases.positive: 同一成年人短发和脸型不变，明确换外套
cases.negative: 无叙事依据改变年龄、脸型和人物身份

cases.positive: 一本书从A递给B，之后仅由B持有
cases.negative: 无交接或复制依据，下一镜A与B同时各持同一本书

cases.positive: 缓慢递出书籍，一个可见动作
cases.negative: 只产生相机推近却声称完成递书表演

cases.positive: 对白起止位于对应镜头内，字幕文字完整
cases.negative: 字幕结束超出成片末尾或漏一条对白

cases.positive: 全部镜头与主版、净版、字幕、项目文件校验一致
cases.negative: 主版损坏或漏交净版，仍标完整交付
